headline.statement: Of 200 alerts, ~163 are real fraud; we catch ~77% of all fraud on the day.

integrity.detail: Every training transaction happens before every test transaction.

integrity.check: Scaler fitted on training data only
integrity.detail: Scaler statistics equal the training-set means, not the test set.
Class weights are used instead, so no synthetic rows can leak across the split.

integrity.check: Label and ID not used as features
integrity.detail: Model inputs are Time, Amount and V1-V28 only.

integrity.check: Probabilities calibrated on training data only
integrity.detail: Platt scaling is fitted on out-of-fold training predictions; it never sees the test day.

integrity.check: Model chosen without the test day
integrity.detail: Selection uses time-ordered cross-validation on training data; the test day is scored once.
Matches the analyst capacity in the brief.
